 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="right"><B>Exhibit 99.1 </B></P> <P STYLE="font-size:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">


<IMG SRC="g128907g0707213145818.jpg" ALT="LOGO">
 </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>Sunbelt Announces Launch of Private Offering of Senior Notes </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">July&nbsp;6, 2026 </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Fort Mill, SC. &#8212;(BUSINESSWIRE)&#8212;
Sunbelt Rentals Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: SUNB, LSE: SUNB) (&#8220;the company&#8221;), a leader in the equipment rental industry, today announced that, subject to market and other conditions, it intends to offer two series of <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">benchmark-sized,</FONT> senior notes (collectively, the &#8220;Notes&#8221;) for sale to eligible purchasers in a private offering (the &#8220;Notes Offering&#8221;). </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The Company intends to use the net proceeds from the Notes Offering for general corporate purposes, which may include, among other things, the repayment,
refinancing or redemption of the Company&#8217;s and its subsidiaries&#8217; existing indebtedness (including amounts under the Company&#8217;s existing credit facility), funding capital expenditures, working capital and other business
opportunities. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The Notes to be offered have not been registered under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the &#8220;Securities Act&#8221;), or any
state securities laws; and, unless so registered, the Notes may not be offered or sold in the United States, except pursuant to an exemption from, or in a transaction not subject to, the registration requirements of the Securities Act and applicable
state securities laws. The Notes are being offered and sold only to persons reasonably believed to be qualified institutional buyers in accordance with Rule 144A under the Securities Act and outside the United States to <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-U.S.</FONT> persons in accordance with Regulation S under the Securities Act. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">This announcement shall not constitute an
offer to sell or a solicitation of an offer to buy any of the Notes, nor shall there be any sale of the Notes in any jurisdiction in which such offer, solicitation or sale of these securities would be unlawful prior to registration or qualification
under the securities laws of any such jurisdiction. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B><U>Forward Looking Statements </U></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Statements made in this announcement that describe the Company&#8217;s intentions, expectations, beliefs or predictions may be forward-looking within the
meaning of securities laws. Forward-looking statements include statements preceded by, followed by or including the words &#8220;believes,&#8221; &#8220;expects,&#8221; &#8220;anticipates,&#8221; &#8220;plans,&#8221; &#8220;estimates,&#8221;
&#8220;projects,&#8221; &#8220;forecasts,&#8221; or similar expressions. Examples of forward-looking statements in this announcement are statements about the Notes Offering and the use of proceeds therefrom. The Company cautions that, by their
nature, forward-looking statements </P>
</DIV></Center>

<P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B><U>About Sunbelt Rentals Holdings, Inc. </U></B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Sunbelt
Rentals Holdings, Inc., operating primarily as Sunbelt Rentals, is a leading global provider of rental equipment and services based in Fort Mill, South Carolina. Our passionate, customer-centric team of 26,000 employees combines execution-focused
resolve with Sunbelt Rentals&#8217; innovative array of rental solutions across a vast network of over 1,600 locations and with a fleet of assets exceeding $19&nbsp;billion. Sunbelt Rentals is committed to delivering unrivaled quality and support
for its customers across an increasingly diverse array of industries, project types and end markets, including construction, live events, maintenance and countless emerging applications ranging from small-scale developments to mega projects. </P>
